mod.name: Arranger: Track Spacer
mod.author: Silent Orbit
mod.description: Adds an empty gap of N pixels above or below tracks in the arranger, like REAPER's track spacers - no extra track. Right-click a track: 'Insert Spacer Before Tracks' / 'Insert Spacer After Tracks' / 'Remove Spacer'. The gap is stored as #spacer-before / #spacer-after in the track comment (optional size, e.g. #spacer-before=24). Undoable. Needs Framework: Actions and Menus.
